items.en: Israeli strike kills Gaza City police chief; IDF claims targeting militants at police station.

items.en: Iran reportedly weighs potential strikes on US military targets in Europe if war escalates.

items.en: Ukraine says Russian drone strike on Zhytomyr police building kills 2, injures over 20.
